SRC-048:R001.text: They were blocking T-1310's own-scope closure solely because coverage is receipt-wide, creating the circular dependency the operator resolved in SRC-047 Decision A: T-1310 must close on its own verified product scope.

SRC-048:R002.text: The 22 superseded SRC-046 clauses carry re-homed coverage ownership under their actual descendant tickets per SRC-047 Decision A, and the obligations remain mandatory under the descendants own Work contracts.
